html:
Question 12
?

Determine the domain of the vector field F on R2, given by

F(x,y)=ln⁡(x−y2)i+(x2+y2)e1/xj.

a
 {(x,y)∈R2|x>0}
b
{(x,y)∈R2|x>y2}
c
 {(x,y)∈R2|x>y2,x≠1}
d
 {(x,y)∈R2|x>y2,x>1}
e
 {(x,y)∈R2|x<y2}
Submit
